parentCommit: bc8066ff Record post-unlock ODA integrity recheck
scope: Bound DRW_View default-lighting enum values for DXF output without changing DWG parsing or encoding.

sources.claim: ViewTableRecord inherits AbstractViewTableRecord, which provides the default-lighting property.
DefaultLightingType contains OneDistantLight and TwoDistantLights, corresponding to values 0 and 1.
The official VIEW DXF table omits group 282; the current writer nevertheless emits this inherited property as group 282.

implementation.behavior: DRW_View::validateDxf now requires m_defaultLightingType <= 1 alongside its existing renderMode <= 6 guard. DWG parseDwg/encodeDwg continue to use payload-width validation. The VIEW group-282 mapping itself remains unqualified because the current Autodesk VIEW DXF table does not list that group.
implementation.failureBehavior: ASCII and Binary VIEW writes reject m_defaultLightingType=2 before record output and preserve an existing destination prefix. The documented upper bound 1 and renderMode upper bound 6 serialize and read back exactly.

focused.coverage: Both ASCII and Binary: renderMode=7 and defaultLightingType=2 refusal preserves an existing destination; renderMode=6/defaultLightingType=1 serialize and read back exactly. Existing VIEW reference mapping, refusal and fresh-writer retry controls pass in the same selector.

limits: No physical VIEW producer or native rendering test was used.
The guard constrains an inherited API enum and does not establish that group 282 is portable in VIEW DXF records.
No DWG parser/encoder behavior changed and no support claim was promoted.
next: Keep the VIEW group-282 mapping and native rendering unqualified; continue source-backed P4/P5 implementation work.
